upgrades.name: Mining licence
upgrades.effect: Pistol, drill, refinery and ammo press. Start with 20 credits. Full HP restores after a successful round. Guaranteed delivery and live selling are available from the start.
upgrades.reason: The core loop is available immediately.

upgrades.name: Deeper bite
upgrades.effect: Drill extraction +7 raw ore per operation.
upgrades.reason: An investment choice before automatic firepower.

upgrades.name: Breach licence
upgrades.effect: Unlock shotgun and shell recipe; 6-shell magazine, strong close-range stagger.
upgrades.reason: A different solution to close packs, not a pistol damage multiplier.

upgrades.name: Worksite armour
upgrades.effect: Maximum HP +15. Full HP restores after a successful round.
upgrades.reason: Survivability has an opportunity cost.

upgrades.name: Tripwire licence
upgrades.effect: Unlock one mine. Normal detonations re-arm next operation.
upgrades.reason: Area denial before permanent autonomous firepower.

upgrades.name: Sentry licence
upgrades.effect: Unlock one sentry; destructible, 20 refined ore to replace.
upgrades.reason: The first autonomous defence should feel earned.

upgrades.name: Survey rifle licence
upgrades.effect: Unlock AR and rifle recipe; 24-round magazine and sustained-fire bloom.
upgrades.reason: Adds mid-range sustained fire, with its own supply pressure.

upgrades.name: Tracking assembly
upgrades.effect: Sentry prioritises nearby drill threats; +25% projectile speed.
upgrades.reason: Reliability, not a large universal DPS multiplier.

upgrades.name: Sure footing
upgrades.effect: Reduce hit slow duration by 40%; no movement-speed stacking.
upgrades.reason: Removes frustrating stunlock without removing threat.

upgrades.name: Core survey
upgrades.effect: Extraction +14 raw ore per operation.
upgrades.reason: Funds the later defensive and weapon choices.

upgrades.name: Scatter specialist
upgrades.effect: Shotgun pellets gently home across up to 3 visible enemies in a 25-degree aiming cone within 12 metres. Split the existing pellet count across targets; no extra pellets or damage and no through-wall targeting.
upgrades.reason: Requested multi-target homing replaces the old lunge-interruption effect. Values remain proposed.

upgrades.name: Indirect fire licence
upgrades.effect: Unlock one mortar. Slow travel and fixed impact point; can miss moving targets.
upgrades.reason: A deliberate group-clear answer, not a universal solution.

upgrades.name: Armour breaker
upgrades.effect: AR rounds penetrate one target at 50% damage.
upgrades.reason: Changes positioning and rewards lining up targets.

upgrades.name: Redundant coverage
upgrades.effect: Unlock a second sentry slot, with independent health and replacement.
upgrades.reason: Coverage is powerful and arrives after multiple roles exist.

upgrades.name: Salvage protocol
upgrades.effect: Failed operations retain 25% unrefined cargo.
upgrades.reason: Softens failure costs; does not make winning easier.

upgrades.name: Deep-core permit
upgrades.effect: Extraction +70 raw ore; requires a pressure contract.
upgrades.reason: Later extraction growth is paid for with danger.

upgrades.name: Controlled burst
upgrades.effect: First 3 AR shots after a pause have 30% less spread.
upgrades.reason: Rewards trigger discipline.

upgrades.name: Rotary emplacement
upgrades.effect: Unlock rotary defence; higher output, slower tracking and wider spread.
upgrades.reason: An alternative defensive role with clear limitations.

upgrades.name: Business continuity
upgrades.effect: One emergency drill repair: 25% health, once per operation.
upgrades.reason: A late safety net, not an early free win.

upgrades.name: Freight licence
upgrades.effect: Guaranteed delivery dispatch size: 40 to 80 ore.
upgrades.reason: New market branch: proposed price, not part of the submitted price edits.

upgrades.name: Demand scanner
upgrades.effect: Shows upcoming demand-event notices on the live market. No guaranteed price forecast.
upgrades.reason: New market branch: proposed price, not part of the submitted price edits.

upgrades.name: Broker agreement
upgrades.effect: Improves live-sale proceeds through a fee reduction from 3% to 1%; all displayed payouts already include fees.
upgrades.reason: New market branch: proposed price, not part of the submitted price edits.

reviewNotes: Original prices and earliest-round values retained for every surviving submitted node.
Machine stat upgrades remain at their own stations, outside company research.
Removed nodes have been bypassed in prerequisites; shotgun and AR specialisations use their own weapon branches.
Market upgrade prices are proposals. Market design awaits approval.
Previous rounds forecast intentionally omitted: it includes removed upgrades and must be recalculated before balancing or implementation.
No in-game research assets or source download modified.
